title: Allow TLS 1.0 for an old partner
what_it_does: Adds one settings file. The program is untouched.
message:
Allow TLS 1.0 for an old partner

The partner's gateway cannot do anything newer yet.
These are the settings for the connection to them.

files.name: partner-gateway.conf
files.text:
# Settings for the connection to the partner's old gateway (demo data).
host = partner-gateway.example.invalid
port = 443
minimum_protocol = TLS 1.0
request_timeout_seconds = 30
